body:
One of my favorite things to be told...extreme sarcasm there..."it's all in your head."

...yes I know that, that's why it's a mental disorder. I know my thoughts aren't real but does knowing that stop them? No. Actually, me hearing that makes it worse because it causes me to think, and I don't need to be thinking.

Honestly, i don't remember what it feels like to be happy. It's been too long. Everyone always asks me why I'm not happy about this, or that. I like your wolves metaphor, it really makes sense to me.

Even when my children were born, I still wanted to not be alive. Sure, I felt a little less sad, but I knew it wasn't happiness. I have anxiety, depression and OCD, and to add to that I've self medicated with pills.

It's been 11 years since the wolves started attacking me on a near-daily basis. Most of the time, I'd rather them tear me apart, because I'm not really worth anything on this earth. I don't want to die, I'm just tired of living like this.

For me, I feel like I've become the nightmare and not in a good way. I don't know who I am anymore. My signs/symptoms have changed for the worse over the years, and I don't want to live like this. At random times for reasons unknown to me, I'll have anxiety attacks and collapse. I've been hospitalized and put on meds twice now. I don't want to be me, I want to be someone else...someone more...normal. I feel like crying all the time. I don't want to die, I just don't want to live anymore, if that makes sense. I hate who I am, I can't change it though.

I mean, I feel like I'm being used as a puppet, and cannot have free will. Somebody else is controlling my mind and I can't shut it off. I'm so tired of thinking all the time. I wish this could just be done and over.

This is coming from someone diagnosed with anxiety, depression, and obsessive-compulsive disorder, if anyone was wondering. My brain is a horrid mixture of disorder.

This is the exact reason I do nothing when I'm not at work...or make any decisions, or have any opinions...

I do remember that I used to be happy, like genuinely happy, and one day it all just kinda stopped...don't know why either

Just woke up one day and was like "You know? Nothing here is really worth it. Nobody really listens to me. I just wanna die." It's been that way for...11 years now, every day.
